description: SKOS-aware hierarchical view of site concepts. Joins vocabulary.json (skos:broader/narrower edges) with pages.json (each page's concepts:[] array) to render a nested <details> tree rooted at top concepts. Counts are distinct pages per subtree; page links are scheme-checked; cyclic edges are skipped. Built by JavaScript (no-JS shows only authored fallback content).

attributes.name: data-lens-src
attributes.description: URL to pages.json. Each page record must expose a concepts:[] array (per meta-tag-contract v1.1). Read at setup; forwarded by content-lens.

attributes.name: data-vocabulary-src
attributes.description: URL to the SKOS vocabulary.json. Provides concept @id, skos:prefLabel, and skos:broader/narrower/hasTopConcept edges used to build the tree.

attributes.name: expand-all
attributes.description: Render with every level expanded. Default opens only the top-level concepts. Read at render (not observed).

attributes.name: data-heading-level
attributes.description: Heading level 1-6 for the panel heading; 0 renders no heading (e.g. inside content-lens, which already labels the lens).

attributes.name: data-label-page
attributes.description: Count template used when Intl.PluralRules selects "one"; {count} is the formatted number.

attributes.name: data-label-pages
attributes.description: Count template for every other plural category.

attributes.name: data-label-uncategorized
attributes.description: Label of the node holding pages whose concepts are not in the vocabulary.

attributes.name: data-label-topic-link
attributes.description: Text of the /topics/{id}/ link inside each node; {label} is the concept prefLabel.

attributes.name: data-label-error
attributes.description: Message when a data source fails to load or the tree cannot be built (detail goes to console.warn, never rendered).

properties.name: data
properties.description: Assign in-memory payloads to bypass the fetch path (takes precedence over data-lens-src while set). Reading returns the assigned payload, or null when the tree came from src.

events.name: topic-map:data-changed
events.description: Fires after the data property is assigned and the tree re-rendered.

structure.description: Generated heading (level from data-heading-level; omitted when 0) with the total page count in <small>.
Generated. One <details> per concept node. data-topic-node carries the concept @id (or '__uncategorized'). Top level opens by default.
Generated. Concept prefLabel as plain text (the summary holds no link, so it only toggles).
Generated. Distinct pages tagged with the concept or any descendant, with unit ("5 pages").
Generated. Link to /topics/{id}/, first item in the disclosure body.
Generated. Pages tagged directly with this concept, in source order. URLs that are not http(s) or relative render as plain text.
